summary: Design governed microlearning, AI tutor flows, and xAPI measures for workplace learning. Explore the course and plan your next learning pilot.
lede: Microlearning and conversational learning use short practice and chat-based guidance to support workplace tasks. For L&D leaders, instructional designers, digital workplace teams, HR technologists, and internal communications professionals, the course covers mapping work processes to learning prompts, designing retrieval-practice sequences and chat flows, setting AI tutor boundaries with human escalation, and using xAPI measures to distinguish engagement from task outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workplace learning, employee guidance, or the digital channels that deliver them. It suits people who can bring a current learning challenge or work process to use in design exercises.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace learning design, instructional design, or L&D operations is expected. Coding or programming is not required; advanced AI and integration concepts are covered at operational or conceptual level, not implementation level.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
